> 第1章 奇葩长老（第1页）
一大清早，这里就聚集了几百位少男少女。
随着一声通报，一位穿着白衣的俊美青年踏入场中。
“拜锤子！拜师千万别选此人！灵仙宗九长老，这可是出了名的奇葩！”
“能把自己修炼到走火入魔，修为倒退，你说奇不奇葩？”
听着周围少男少女的议论声，张云一脸无奈。
他的名声，竟然连这些还未入宗的新晋弟子都知道了……
他本是地球人，五天前突发疾病昏迷醒来后，就发现穿越到了这跟他同名的灵仙宗九长老身上。
但融合记忆后，心情一下就不美妙了。
因为前身这造孽的玩意，竟然在半月前修炼到走火入魔，把自己金丹给搞裂了。
要只是这样就罢了，好歹还有个长老位置混混。
可不知是哪个杀千刀的，得知了此消息在灵仙宗内传播开来，弄的宗内人尽皆知。
多位长老联名请宗主罢黜他这位九长老。
筑基期，在灵仙宗是不配做长老的。
灵仙宗宗主没同意，也没拒绝，而是给了一个方案。
三个月后，是灵仙宗一年一度的弟子大比。届时，宗内长老麾下弟子都会参与，根据弟子的成绩，每位长老都会得到一个年度排名。
张云若进入前三名，长老位保留。反之，罢黜！
别说前三，三个月后能不能有徒弟参加弟子大比都不好说。
得，高起点开局，直接变噩梦开局。

今日正好是灵仙宗三年一度的收徒大典，他抱着死马当活马医的心态前来，想看看能不能收两徒弟。
眼见会场内众多少男少女看向他含着怀疑的眼神，张云苦笑摇头，走上会场内专为长老建起的高台。
刚走上来，耳边就传来了一道讥讽意味明显的笑声，“这不是我们大名鼎鼎的奇葩九长老吗？平日收徒可不见你，怎么，今日竟然有空来收徒了？”
开口的是一位青袍男子，长着一对三角眼，面容一看就很小人。
此人善妒，跟他前身很不对付。两人是同批进入的灵仙宗，都属于修炼天才，以三十岁不到的年纪成就金丹。
不仅如此，在其他方面也处处压制对方一头。

> Chapter 1 The Weird Elder (Page 1)
Early in the morning, hundreds of boys and girls gathered here.
Following an announcement, a handsome young man in white stepped into the arena.
"Thank you! Don't choose this person to be your disciple! The ninth elder of Lingxian Sect is famous for being weird!"
"Do you think it's strange that you can cultivate yourself to the point of going crazy and regressing in your cultivation?"
Listening to the discussions of the boys and girls around him, Zhang Yun looked helpless.
His reputation is even known to these new disciples who have not yet joined the sect...
He was originally from Earth. When he woke up from a coma due to illness five days ago, he found that he had traveled through time and space in the body of the ninth elder of the Lingxian Sect with the same name as him.
But after merging the memories, the mood suddenly became unsatisfactory.
Because the evil thing in his predecessor had gone so far in cultivation half a month ago that he cracked his golden elixir.
If that's all, at least there's still a gangster in the elder position.
But I don't know who killed Qian Dao. After learning about this news, it spread within Lingxian Sect, making everyone in the sect aware of it.
Many elders jointly requested the sect leader to depose him, the ninth elder.
During the foundation building period, one is not qualified to be an elder in the Lingxian Sect.
The leader of Lingxian Sect did not agree or refuse, but gave a plan.
Three months later, it was the Lingxian Sect’s annual disciple competition. At that time, the disciples of the elders in the sect will participate, and each elder will receive an annual ranking based on the performance of the disciples.
Zhang Yunruo entered the top three and retained his position as elder. On the contrary, dismiss him!
Not to mention the top three, it is hard to say whether any disciples will be able to participate in the disciple competition in three months.
Yes, a high starting point turns into a nightmare start.
Today happened to be the Lingxian Sect's three-year apprenticeship ceremony. He came here with the mentality of being a dead horse and trying to accept two disciples.
Seeing how many boys and girls in the venue looked at him with suspicious eyes, Zhang Yun smiled bitterly and shook his head, then walked up to the high platform built specifically for the elders in the venue.
As soon as I walked up, a sarcastic laughter came to my ears, "Isn't this our famous and weird Ninth Elder? I don't see you accepting disciples on weekdays. Why, you are free to accept disciples today?"
The person who spoke was a man in green robes, with a pair of triangular eyes and a face that looked very small.
This person is jealous and has a hard time dealing with his predecessor. The two of them entered the Lingxian Sect in the same batch. They are both geniuses in cultivation and achieved the Golden Elixir at the age of less than thirty years old.
Not only that, but he also suppressed the opponent in other aspects.
For example, it took the predecessor only one and a half years to practice the same kind of combat skills, but it took this person two years. The previous task of hunting the same kind of spiritual beast took half a month, but this person spent a whole day.
